# dsh-pele-mermaid

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that renders Mermaid
diagrams inside the Web GUI with Pele — a fast,
zero-

dependency, themeable Mermaid-to-SVG renderer — both in Markdown document
previews and in chat trans

ncy, themeable Mermaid-to-SVG renderer — both in Markdown document
previews and in chat transcripts.
## Screenshots

Tall diagrams collapse into a compact preview card that keeps the diagram
readable (default 100%) wi

thout stretching the conversation; ordinary wheel
scrolling still scrolls the chat.

Clicking the preview opens a frame-wide viewer with drag-to-pan, wheel zoom,
fit-to-diagram / fit-to
-width / 1:1 / reset, and Escape to close.
## What it does

The built-in sidebar document preview renders Markdown files as plain text, so
Mermaid fenced code b

locks show up as source. This bundle registers an
alternative preview implementation, `Markdown + Me

rmaid`, that becomes the
default for `.md`, `.markdown`, `.mmd`, and `.mermaid` files:

- Fenced code blocks tagged `mermaid` render as SVG diagrams via Pele, themed
from the DSH theme tok

ens (`--dsw-alias-*`), adapting to light and dark
themes.
- Everything else renders through the stan

dard `MarkdownText` primitive, so
headings, code blocks, math, footnotes, and images behave as befor

e.
- `.mmd` / `.mermaid` files render the whole file as one diagram.
- A diagram Pele cannot parse f

alls back to an error box with the parse
message; use the viewer dropdown in the preview header to s

witch back to the
built-in Markdown renderer at any time.
## Chat transcripts

The built-in chat has no fence-level rendering hook (`MarkdownText` is a closed
primitive), so inste

ad of replacing the whole assistant node view, a hidden
component rides the `conversation.chat.turnT

ail` list slot and watches the
transcript DOM. Candidate code blocks are identified by shape — an
un

highlighted `pre`, where registered languages render `pre.shiki` or a
highlight div — and by content

: Pele's `detectType` must recognize the text as
a diagram. Each accepted block is hidden in place a

nd followed by a sibling
element holding the Pele-rendered SVG. Only DOM the built-in renderer does

not
manage (inline style, the inserted sibling) is touched, so streaming, edits,
and React reconcili

ation keep working. While a source does not parse yet (for
example while it is still streaming in),

the ordinary code block stays visible;
the diagram appears as soon as the source parses.

A diagram that would stand taller than ~420 px in the column (after fitting to
the column width) get

s a compact 340 px preview instead of stretching the
transcript. The preview keeps the diagram at a

readable scale, fades into an
explicit expansion affordance, and never captures ordinary wheel scrol

ling.
Clicking it opens a frame-wide viewer through `shell.overlay` with drag-to-pan,
wheel zoom, Fi

t diagram, Fit width, 1:1, Reset, and Escape controls. The viewer
starts at Fit width (capped at 100

%) so a very tall diagram stays readable;
Fit diagram remains available for an overview. Shorter dia

grams render inline
as before; the document preview keeps its inline rendering.

es the lower bound to

## Develop

The client bundle is hand-targeted at the `window.__ModuleLoader__` factory
format: React and `@deep

seek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` resolve against the
web shell's static module table, and Pele is i
nlined into the bundle.
